title: Waku Waku 7 (Demo)
overview:
Here they come, the top-marks, full-of-energy Waku Waku fighters!!

A wide variety of moves, fiery battles! The Waku Waku Gauge, with all sorts of uses

Legend says that whoever gathers all seven Waku Waku Balls will have any wish granted. Seven fighters each hold one ball, and now they battle to claim the rest.

Waku Waku 7 is a one-on-one 2D fighting game with a colorful anime-style cast. Use light and hard punches and kicks, dashes, throws and special moves in timed best-of-three bouts. Land attacks to fill your Waku Waku Gauge, then spend it on powerful super moves.

This disc is a demo version of the game. The full game requires the Extended RAM Cartridge.

- 1-2 players
- Waku Waku Gauge powers super moves
- Unique Waku Waku Throw for every character

参上、花マル元気のわくわくファイター！！

多彩な技、燃えるバトル！使い方イロイロ［わくわくゲージ］
